quoted_tweet.author: Yuri Bezmenov's Ghost
quoted_tweet.text: To be demoralized is to have your sense of reality so inverted that you fail to recognize you are in a state of war, mistake those attacking you for victims, and willingly assist them in undermining your own society while believing you are doing something good.
